_about: Sessions, the same in both SDKs (2026-09-25): where a served agent keeps a caller's conversation,
which session a request names, what is kept of a turn, what the chat records on Robutler, how /resume
merges this machine's list with Robutler's, and the sentences both chats say.
owners gives the caller in neutral terms (tier: owner, admin or null; principals: what an access block
verified, or null when none ran; user_id: a platform credential's user) and each SDK builds its own auth from it.

owners.case: an admin is a caller like any other
the first identity an access block verified
an access block that verified nobody

keep.case: the words of the request and the reply

words_since.case: the new user and assistant text, after what is already recorded
a long reply is cut to 100000 characters

merge.case: recorded from here is one row; the rest are their own rows; newest first

sentences.signed_out: Conversations stay on this machine: sign in with `webagents login` to keep them on Robutler too.
sentences.not_published: Conversations stay on this machine: publish this agent with `webagents publish` to keep them on Robutler too.
sentences.failure_401: your sign-in has expired: run `webagents login`
sentences.failure_404: Robutler does not know this agent as yours
sentences.backend: session: backend must be "local" or "robutler", not "cloud".
